 After 27 years, Heidi Klum is defending her crown as Halloween queen with her latest star-studded costume party.
 On Saturday, the supermodel host of Project Runway hit the red carpet of her 25th Halloween Party—which skipped two years during COVID—debuting her 2026 costume, very graphic, blinged-out severed hand.
 In addition to Klum, this year’s guest list included Kyle MacLachlan, Questlove, Andrew Rannells, Eric McCormack and more.
 Scroll on to see who dressed as what for Heidi Klum’s Halloween party.
